scope: Source and isolated frontend tests only; no production requests or Jira/VP edits in this display review.

findings.finding: Editing controls left the old rankings and heatmap visible while PDF used the new controls. Old results also survived failed refreshes.
reproduction: Change the season or zone without running again.
The old result stayed visible while the PDF used the changed inputs.
findings.repair: Results and export inputs are now tied to the successful request. Changed, loading and failed states hide results and disable PDF. Old requests cannot replace newer results.
findings.failed_browser_observation: The production check reproduced the issue: TOR/BOS 2021-22 tables and a 376-shot image stayed visible with Export PDF enabled after selecting 2024-25 without Run.

findings.finding: The caption summary, copied text and PNG filename used unsent filters while the old image remained visible.
findings.repair: Only a successful matching request provides the visible image, summary and PNG filename. Pending, changed and failed states do not offer downloads.

findings.finding: Preview labels followed edited controls while table rows remained from the earlier query; CSV used the edited inputs.
findings.repair: Preview rows and labels now use the successful result. CSV uses its captured filters and stays disabled until the current inputs succeed. Empty results are explained.

findings.finding: The preferred route required our but the client sent team. It then retried real validation/no-data responses against a legacy route that could return a blank image as success.
findings.repair: The client uses the current route with our and preserves failures. No legacy fallback replaces an empty matchup with a successful blank court.

findings.finding: The PDF URL omitted the heatmap sampling cap, so the PDF could use more attempts than the displayed image.
findings.repair: The successful maxShots input is now sent as max_shots. Root is aligning the backend PDF sampling and renderer.
findings.status: Client fixed; backend integration and PDF-image parity pending

findings.finding: The image used automatic per-image color scaling, switched between linear and log counts, and had no numeric legend. The Shot Plan tip described opponent weaknesses even though the plot only counts attempts.
findings.repair: Frontend copy now says attempt counts including makes and misses, with attacking-basket orientation. Root is adding explicit renderer scale and sample counts.
findings.status: Frontend copy fixed; renderer integration pending

findings.finding: EPA was shown as an unexplained column code, and the initial hardcoded 2021-22 prevented the intended newest-season default.
findings.repair: Tables identify estimated points per attempt and season-long offense/opponent-defense scope. The default season comes from current shot metadata. Missing numbers show Unavailable.

reviewed_without_new_issue: Top K maps to k=1..10 and returns up to that many shot-type/zone rows. No minimum-attempt control is offered or claimed; backend shrinks small samples and reports attempts.
Offense weight maps to w_off; defense weight is 1-w_off. Ranking blends season-long offensive and opponent defensive points per attempt.
Heatmap filters are matchup-only and separate from season-long ranking inputs. Current preset labels resolve against arc3/corner3/mid/paint/rim.

Saved Shot Model Metrics fetches five-fold saved results; loading/error states remove old results and exports. Training and later-season results are separated, and the page states that proposed location/type are inputs rather than pre-possession forecasts.
limitations: The independent source-data review found a zone boundary error. Rebuild and new metrics are required before claiming current shot results are correct.
No live-browser download or final production verification was performed by this display audit.

frontend_validation.typescript: Passed before count-display addition; root running the full final typecheck/build.
